title: 9 Towing Mistakes That Wreck Your Truck (And the Recall That Told 456,000 Owners: Don't Tow)
description:
In February twenty twenty-six, more than four hundred fifty thousand Ram and Jeep owners got a warning nobody expects from a truck company: do not tow. A faulty module could leave trailers with no turn signals, no brake lights, and in some cases no trailer brakes at all. And that recall is only one of the ways towing can go wrong without the driver ever noticing.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

1:07 The 2026 towing recall
2:14 Mistake 1: Skipping the check
3:11 Mistake 2: Trusting the big number
5:14 Mistake 3: Wrong tongue weight
6:38 Mistake 4: Panicking in sway
7:59 Mistake 5: Driving too fast
9:21 Mistake 6: Cooking the brakes
10:22 Mistake 7: Chains and breakaway
11:22 Mistake 8: Ignoring maintenance
12:43 Mistake 9: The wrong truck
14:27 Common towing situations
18:47 Habits of good towers
19:49 Your towing checklist
